mission: Convert the M11 result stack into one JGPS-facing philosophical argument, distinguish discovery from representation-diagnostic consequences, carry one claim-to-capacity application through to its evidential consequence, repair supplement promises, and prepare—but not fabricate—independent human re-adjudication.

immutable_scientific_results.encoding_permissive_weaker_arms: six weaker tested views each 40/40 A0
immutable_scientific_results.direct_preservation_weaker_arms: six weaker tested views each 0/40 A0 and 40/40 A1
immutable_scientific_results.CPCG: 206 -> 143 signatures; 63/99 original cross-stratum families collide; 62 cross-stratum signatures; 58/60 claims retain cross-stratum support

central_thesis: Structural comparison can bear evidential weight in cognitive-capacity individuation only relative to an explicitly declared comparison representation, preservation criterion, and granularity.

dialectical_targets.inference_form: Repeated or shared inherited construct terminology is itself evidence of capacity identity or a stable capacity boundary.
dialectical_targets.m12_constraint: Label continuity can organize an inquiry but cannot discharge structural identity. A same-label bundle inherits preservation debt until a cross-source bridge or invariant is independently established.
dialectical_targets.empirical_anchor: MEM04 x CNC05 share 'semantic memory' but have zero frozen bounded-archetype overlap and zero CPCG-signature overlap.
dialectical_targets.not_claimed: The two sources prove that semantic memory is not one capacity.

dialectical_targets.inference_form: Successful reconstruction or unification of heterogeneous source models within one formal representation is, by itself, evidence that the represented capacity structure is privileged or identity-bearing.
dialectical_targets.m12_constraint: Encoding success is insufficient for basis selection. If weaker encodings preserve reconstruction success, an additional preservation or perspicuity argument is required.
dialectical_targets.empirical_anchor: MAIN40 remains 40/40 A0 under the full basis and six encoding-permissive weaker views.
dialectical_targets.not_claimed: The weaker views are equally perspicuous, true, or explanatorily adequate.

dialectical_targets.inference_form: Structural invariance observed under one chosen representation/transformation class can be promoted without further argument to representation-independent capacity identity.
dialectical_targets.m12_constraint: Invariance supports individuation only relative to a justified class of representations/transformations; lossless TAIF and lossy CPCG separate non-uniqueness from robustness.
dialectical_targets.empirical_anchor: TAIF changes first-class factorization losslessly; CPCG collapses substantial fine structure while retaining substantial higher-order reuse.
dialectical_targets.not_claimed: All plausible rival representations have been exhausted.

north_positioning.stance: M12 does not deny objective or non-pragmatic perspicuity.
north_positioning.relation: The evidential-burden procedure is prior to a perspicuity verdict: successful encoding cannot establish perspicuity; a claim that one representation is objectively better requires an additional argument tying representational structure to target structure.
north_positioning.boundary: Purpose-relative preservation criteria are methodological commitments and are not asserted to exhaust objective representational quality.

brousalis_positioning.relation: M12 operationalizes one precondition on epistemically relevant similarity/difference: the dimensions and preservation rule of comparison must be declared before similarity can carry normative evidential weight.
brousalis_positioning.boundary: No claim is made about generalism, particularism, localism, or realism beyond this comparison-level constraint.

beni_positioning.relation: Candidate unifying structures such as predictive-processing/FEP-style frameworks may be scientifically valuable, but unification success alone does not establish representation-independent kind or capacity identity. M12 specifies an upstream evidential burden on such uses.
beni_positioning.boundary: M12 does not adjudicate whether Beni's PP/FEP candidate is in fact the most perspicuous or empirically best framework.

onishi_serpico_positioning.relation: Interest-relativity is exposed rather than eliminated: selecting system boundaries, preservation criteria, and granularities is an inquiry-relative act whose consequences should be made explicit and sensitivity-tested.
onishi_serpico_positioning.boundary: The method does not recover a purpose-independent natural taxonomy.

downstream_application.candidate_thesis: The recurring label 'semantic memory' in MEM04 and CNC05 can itself contribute evidence that the two claims support one structurally individuated capacity.
test_chain: identify the shared inherited label without treating it as a structural feature
compare frozen bounded support under the working basis
compare the same supports under lossy CPCG
if supports remain disjoint, classify the label-only route to identity as evidentially insufficient
do not reject a unified semantic-memory capacity; state the additional evidence needed
downstream_application.allowed_conclusion: The label-only evidential route is defeated for this pair. A unified capacity thesis remains open but acquires a burden to specify a cross-source preservation/invariance bridge.
downstream_application.prohibited_conclusion: Semantic memory is not a capacity or MEM04 and CNC05 concern different capacities.

result_taxonomy.SOURCE_GROUNDED_FINDING: Depends on reviewed source interpretation/adjudication and can in principle vary under competent recoding.
result_taxonomy.REPRESENTATION_DIAGNOSTIC: Deterministic or near-deterministic consequence used to diagnose granularity, forgetting, or representational sensitivity rather than a direct cognitive-science discovery.
result_taxonomy.CONSTRUCTED_CONTROL: Counterfactual/synthetic manipulation designed to establish reachability or sensitivity, not an observed corpus outcome.
result_taxonomy.EXPOSITORY_WITNESS: Post hoc example used to make a frozen general pattern concrete, not a prevalence test.

preclassified_results.reason: primarily diagnoses an over-discriminating whole-claim comparison surface; scalar-stage failures dominate before topology
reconstruction finding conditional on reviewed claims and forgetting operator
prospective source-grounded compatibility under fixed A-state semantics; not grammar validation
deterministic sensitivity consequence under explicit generic-encoding contract
deterministic sensitivity consequence given known role usage and preservation debt rule
deterministic sensitivity under one frozen lossy rival; informative about robustness/collapse, not independent empirical replication
post hoc worked examples from frozen evidence

label_suppression_boundary.lexical_comparison_leakage: Historical construct labels are excluded from comparison calculations.
label_suppression_boundary.required_manuscript_sentence: Label suppression blocks direct lexical inheritance in the comparator; it does not establish that author-mediated source coding was conceptually blind to construct identity.

human_readjudication_protocol.original_claim_sampling: 2 cases from each of eight primary strata plus 4 challenge cases, selected deterministically by SHA256 rank from the exact M11 parent state
human_readjudication_protocol.prospective_sampling: 6 component and 4 integrated cases selected deterministically by SHA256 rank within corpus arm from the frozen MAIN40 paper-level table
human_readjudication_protocol.independent_coder_requirement: A competent human who did not produce the original adjudication should code without access to the answer key during coding.
claim_variables: bounded-object support decision for supplied candidates
reporting_plan: Cohen kappa for single categorical outcomes when defined
disagreement ledger with source-grounded resolution deferred until after blind coding
human_readjudication_protocol.prohibited_result: No agreement statistic may be reported until a completed independent human response file exists.
